desc:
🌿 Welcome to Grow a Cafe!

🌱 Grow coffee trees and harvest COOL beans!
🫘 Blend beans to create your own SIGNATURE coffee!
☕ Brew custom drinks and serve happy customers!
🏡 Design, build, and expand your dream cafe!
🧑‍🍳 Hire workers to keep your cafe running!
✨ Discover SECRET recipes with amazing effects!

Your cafe earns money offline! 💵

Game is in alpha, PLEASE ❤️ send feedback in settings!
